verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated snapshot/restore doc. It describes checkpointing an initialized workspace, claiming new sandboxes from that snapshot's filesystem state, and rolling an existing sandbox back. It also documents forking a running or paused sandbox, and the coding-agents use case shows claiming parallel sandboxes from a snapshot ID. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that snapshot, restore and fork work as documented.
